purpose: Prevent action-level, scalar-core, and phenomenological-fluid descriptions from being silently combined.

action_based_derivation_target.role: Use as the sole input for any next action-derived homogeneous equations unless this specification is explicitly superseded.

legacy_candidate.role: Separate scalar-only conformally coupled model; do not treat as a reduction of the scalar-vector action without a derived limit or field-elimination argument.

phenomenological_paper_model.model: Fluid interaction with Q = 3 H xi(a) rho_c and constant intrinsic w_0
phenomenological_paper_model.role: Phenomenological target model; do not identify it with either action above without deriving its fluid equations and perturbation prescription from that action.

conditional_matching_results.premise: The current action specification's structural matter-continuity equation is valid, matter is pressureless, and H and rho_c are nonzero.
conditional_matching_results.action_level_continuity: dot(rho_c) + 3 H rho_c = - gamma_m dot(phi) rho_c
conditional_matching_results.paper_continuity: dot(rho_c) + 3 H rho_c = 3 H xi(a) rho_c
does_not_establish: symbolically verified variation of the current action
equivalence of the full background systems
equivalence of perturbation equations or observables

conditional_matching_results.premise: The legacy scalar-only core's supplied dust continuity equation is valid and H and rho_c are nonzero.
conditional_matching_results.warning: This is a different action and parameter convention from the current scalar-vector specification.

current_action_vector_boundary.supplied_vector_equation: alpha_A nabla_mu F^{mu nu} - m_A^2 A^nu - beta_phi_A phi^2 A^nu - xi_A R^nu_mu A^mu = 0
current_action_vector_boundary.discrepancy: A previously recorded structural constraint used a plus sign before xi_A R_00/N^2. That sign does not follow from the supplied mixed-index vector equation with signature (-+++) and lapse N. Re-derive directly from the action before treating either form as verified.
current_action_vector_boundary.conditional_consequence: If the coefficient obtained from the supplied vector equation is nonzero, A_0 = 0; a nonzero homogeneous A_0 requires the coefficient to vanish.
current_action_vector_boundary.status: INDEX-RAISING SIGN CHECK; ACTION VARIATION NOT SYMBOLICALLY PROVED
not_established: existence or stability of a viable exceptional branch
physical relevance of a nonzero temporal-vector background
the exact vector constraint from an independently verified variation of the action

repository_status_reconciliation.repository_closure: STATUS.md and docs/status/NEXT_CLOSURE_MOVE.md declare the reproducibility surface closed.
repository_status_reconciliation.scientific_boundary: Those files explicitly do not claim final cosmological truth, Lambda-CDM rejection, dark-sector closure, or independent likelihood validation.
repository_status_reconciliation.action_derivation_boundary: The current action, variational check, and cosmological reduction ansatz explicitly remain structural; reduced equations are not marked as derived and symbolic variation is not proved.
repository_status_reconciliation.interpretation: Repository reproducibility closure and scientific derivation closure are distinct statuses; there is no logical contradiction once their scopes are kept separate.

decision.working_rule: For action-derived work, start only from the current scalar-vector action specification. Treat the scalar-only core and the fluid-level paper model as separate until an explicit derivation establishes a relation.
not_claimed: a unique physically canonical model has been selected by evidence
the interaction ansatz is empirically supported
any new cosmological prediction has been established

scope: substitute the current action's FLRW metric and homogeneous scalar/temporal-vector ansatz
derive the reduced Euler-Lagrange equations from the reduced action

next_admissible_step.stop_condition: Stop at the first sign, normalization, lapse-variation, or boundary-term ambiguity; do not produce predictions before the reduced equations are verified.
